title: Watch the computer play
summary: The autopilot plays your campaign while you watch. Stop hands control straight back.
text:
In the title screen's Options, **Watch the computer play** hands your campaign to an autopilot. It builds, defends, researches, reads and answers each story card, sits through the cinematics and travels when the story calls, while a camera follows what matters.

- The **AUTOPILOT** badge says what it's doing, sets its speed and has **Stop**, which hands control straight back
- Move the camera yourself and it stands back for a few seconds
- Options choose how it answers story cards, and an **Assist** that helps it past a stuck objective or a colony about to fall

It plays **your** colony, so its choices are yours to live with. You can turn it on again from the menu.
